raw_segments.text: Antony, post back with speed and tell him what hath chank'd.
Here is a morning Rome, a dangerous Rome, no Rome of safety for Octavius yet.
High hence and tell him so.
Yet stay a while, thou shalt not back till I have borne this course into the market-place.
There shall I try in my oration how the people take the cruel issue of these bloody men,
according to the which thou shalt discourse to young Octavius of the state of things.
